articles.title: Boeing Stock Rises After NTSB Crash Report. Analysts Remain Bullish.
articles.mainIdea: Boeing Stock Rises After NTSB Crash Report. Analysts Remain Bullish.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Boeing Stock Rises After NTSB Crash Report. Analysts Remain Bullish.. Boeing stock is having another good day. Shares of the commercial jet maker added 2.1%, closing at $247.74, while the and gained 0.3% and 0.6%, respectively. The move came after an accident update from the National Transportation Safety Board regarding the United Parcel Service MD-11 cargo jet that crashed shortly after takeoff in Kentucky on Nov. 4, 2025, killing 14 and injuring 23 more. Related tickers mentioned: BA, UPS, ^DJI, ^GSPC.
